label: H100 SXM
notes: hashcat v6.2.6 mode 1400 (single SHA-256) on 8x H100 80GB HBM3: 16.16 GH/s per GPU. Bitcoin hashes the block header twice (SHA-256d), so mining rate is taken as half: 8.08 GH/s. Power uses the GPU's all-in kW at full load.

label: B200
notes: No public SHA-256 benchmark for B200. Scaled from H100 SXM by FP32 throughput (75 vs 67 TFLOPS; integer hashing runs on the same CUDA cores): 8.08 x 75/67 = 9.04 GH/s. Power uses the GPU's all-in kW at full load.

label: Antminer S23 (air)
notes: Bitmain's current air-cooled Bitcoin ASIC, shipping since Jan 2026: 318 TH/s at 3,498 W (11 J/TH). Hydro version: 580 TH/s at 9.5 J/TH.
